_comment: Two default sets (MODEL_SET=official|unimpeded, start.sh/serve.sh --set, start.bat/serve.ps1 -ModelSet; default unimpeded). One object per set and role: pick names the config/models-manifest.json entry of that role (or of the role in from); file is informational (sha256, revision, license live there). official = the vendor's own GGUF, or ggml-org's conversion when the vendor ships none. unimpeded = the least-restricted variant that passes our functional checks; fallback=official marks a role with no such variant (it serves the official model, or the current default when that is the same weights). Objects without a file are roles not on main yet; serve.sh / serve.ps1 ignore them. Role hierarchy: coder can do everything, general (chat) usually can but may be weak at development, specialists only do their task but are preferred for it. Read by scripts/lib/manifest.awk: keep one key per line and no escaped quotes.

sets.vendor: LiquidAI (the general role's file with the coder profile)
ggml-org (no uncensored variant; a classifier has nothing to unlock)
ggml-org conversion of google/embeddinggemma-2 (Google ships no GGUF)
unsloth requant of google/embeddinggemma-2 (the current default; no uncensored embedding model exists, embeddings refuse nothing)
Qwen (JEV runs its own fixed prompts)
